text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (—That person was a beacon of light.)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf! She achieves the Triple 
Crown! Radiantly holding three fingers up 
to the heavens!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —However, this is not the end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want to create it. A world where every 
Umamusume can find happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the "Emperor" everyone believes in! I 
shall prove that hope is boundless!

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "The 'Emperor'...! Oooohhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, the President's words were 
difficult for me. I didn't understand all 
of it, but...)

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "So strong... So incredible...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I don't understand it, yet I'm drawn to 
it. My chest is aching so intensely with 
longing.)

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Huh. There was a time when Rudolf wasn't 
the number one favorite? And she was even 
injured once—..."

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Ooh... wow...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf wins! Symboli Rudolf 
stands at the pinnacle of the world!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! The Emperor is absolute!" 
"Yeah, there's no way she'd ever lose to 
anyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehehn! Rudolf-san winning is an 
'absolute guarantee'!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: “—I will, without fail.”

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"—You've gotta get better. You're 
definitely gonna get strong..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Now, 18 elites gather for the Nippon 
Derby to determine Japan's very best. 
Bringing you the live commentary will 
be—...”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, the Prez is watching the Derby too~

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A day beyond measure, of priceless 
treasures. Today is truly an irreplaceable 
day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And figuring out who will be this year's 
Derby Umamusume... is also part of my job.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby is finally starting, huh! 
I wonder who this year's Derby Umamusume 
will be...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it bound to be one of the Big Three? 
Like the favorite, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Fufun! Did you know, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"‘Becoming the trainer of a Derby 
Umamusume is harder than becoming Prime 
Minister’— that's just how rare winning 
the Derby is!"

The day of the Japan Derby. We were in the 
stands, not on the turf.
—I couldn't run.

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi Tsurumaru-san, let's start by 
taking your temperature, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um. Weren't you supposed to be discharged 
today...?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Sensei said that? ...I'll check with 
them later.

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's examination and 
treatment took a little longer than 
expected. And then—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hau... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Let's start with what you can manage. 
Slowly let your stomach get used to it~."

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's condition hadn't 
fully returned to normal.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh——!!

I've acquired the technique to shift into 
top gear in an instant. My top speed 
hasn't dropped since before my 
hospitalization, either!
—And yet...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hahuu... haff... haaah—fuuu—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's take a deep breath~. Alright, 
breathe in~... and out~...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight, let's keep going while walking 
this time~.

She could only maintain top speed up to 
'1800m'.
choice_data_list: (I won't last 2400 meters in the Derby...)

text_block_list.text:
Restoring collapsed building blocks takes 
just as much time as it did to stack them 
up in the first place.

Even though her abilities have grown. Even 
though she has worked this hard.

If it were her, she definitely would have 
run in the Derby—
(Snap)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Working without turning the lights on is 
gonna ruin your eyesight~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer-san.
Even so, time passed relentlessly.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Now, since you couldn't run, you at least 
have to study!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you can't run in the race, if you 
come to watch, there are things you can 
do!"
choice_data_list:
...So you're really going to watch the 
race from here today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes, because it's the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Watching it through a screen... feels like 
such a waste, don't you think?! You really 
have to see it live!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: ...Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! Oh, right, let's head to the 
paddock too!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry, hurry! —Hurry up!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... whew... Ah—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, over here! Over here, over 
hereee!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! For leaving you behind... Um—
(Wooooaaaah!)
choice_data_list: ...! But it looks like it just started.
...! But it looks like it just started.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Special Weeek!! King Halooo!! Seiun 
Skyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"A first-class name isn't just for show, 
King—!" "Sky~! Flip this Derby on its 
head~~!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: SPECIAL WEEEEEEKKKK!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"You can definitely win this! If it's you, 
absolutely!! Show them what the favorite 
is made of—!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Yes! I will definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely become the number one 
Umamusume in Japan!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ……"Guaranteed to win"……

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll overcome this experience and become 
even stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ......I'm alright!
(Wooooo!)

And so, the Nippon Derby began— the race 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi couldn't run in—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"They can't pull level! They can't even 
draw close!! In the blink of an eye, 
Special Week takes the lead!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She blows past them in an instant! It's 
Special Week! She's pulling away from the 
pack!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the one who seized the dream in this 
year's Nippon Derby is Special Week!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
She did iiiiiit! I knew it, Special! I 
just knew you'd take 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is definitely going to win 
the next Kikuka Sho too! No doubt about 
it!!

(WOOOOOOAAAAAAAARRGHH!!) (Clap clap clap 
clap――)
(――*snap*)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I'm definitely going to be 
okay.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I must have that same "absolute" 
that Symboli Rudolf has!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Phew—...
(Snap)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Good night.
